verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine: it streams MoE expert weights from SSD, ships LoRA/prerouter adapters, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and runs as on-device apps. Event-driven automation rules that trigger actions are a workflow-automation capability, not something buyers compare inference runtimes on. Nothing in the evidence shows Edge0 ships any trigger or rules feature that would make this axis applicable.
